description: Na₂TiSi₄H₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P42_12 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.52 Å. Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.75 Å) and four longer (1.96 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.65 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom.
